p: Jalan Muhammad Kahfi II - Srengseng Sawah Jagakarsa

This area is a lake, but it is where the indigenous Betawi set up an area for outsiders to know their culture. The weekend is especially the perfect time to visit as the food stalls are set up for you to savor Jakarta's local cuisine…
Jl. Moch. Kahfi II No.21 A, Srengseng Sawah, Jagakarsa
Serves some Betawi cuisine such as Pecak gurame (Gourami fish in spicy Betawi sauce) and Gabus pucung (Snakehead fish in black soup).
